question: If g = (2 - √3), what will be the value of (g³-(1)/(g³))?
solution:
**Given:**

g = (2 - √3)

Formula Used:

a³ - b³ = (a - b)³ + 3ab (a - b)

**Calculation:**

g = 2 - √3

⇒ 1/g = 2 + √3
